
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lulight/p/23734982" title="发布于 2026-11-20 21:09">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【Azure Developer】.NET 10搭建登录认证示例(Identity + JWT + Refresh Token)</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<blockquote>
<p>本文是一个动手示例，跟随一步一步，可以把项目真正跑起来。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="2">从创建项目开始，实现注册、登录、JWT 验证、Refresh Token 轮换、MCP 鉴权，最后补上一个能实际操作的中文页面。</p>
</blockquote>
<h1 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="2">最终效果：一张动态图看完整流程</h1>
<p><img alt="auth-flow" width="333" height="394" loading="lazy" style="border: 2px solid rgba(0, 0, 139, 1)" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202611/2127802-20261120201212973-1573053826.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>动态图：</strong><em>未认证首页 → 注册表单 → 注册成功 → 登录成功 → 获取天气 → 退出登录。</em></p>
<p>本文将要完成的示例，是一条真正闭环的认证链路：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">注册账户
   ↓
Identity 验证用户名和密码
   ↓
签发 Access Token </span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Refresh Token
   ↓
客户端携带 Bearer Token
   ↓
访问天气 API 或 MCP 工具
   ↓
Access Token 到期后使用 Refresh Token 换新</span></pre>
</div>
<p>如果没有完成认证，会直接跳转到一个自定义页面，并提示：“当前尚未认证，请先注册或登录。”</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>一：创建项目并安装依赖</h1>
<h2 id="1-%E5%87%86%E5%A4%87%E7%8E%AF%E5%A2%83" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="111">1. 准备环境</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="113">本文使用：</p>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="115">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="115">.NET 10 SDK。</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="116">PowerShell 7。</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="117">VS Code 或 Visual Studio。</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="118">SQLite。</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="119">原生 HTML、CSS、JavaScript。</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto" data-line="121">不需要额外安装数据库服务，也不需要 Node.js 前端构建工具。</p>
<p dir="auto" data-line="123">检查 SDK：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>dotnet --version</pre>
</div>
<p>应当能够使用 .NET 10 SDK, 本项目验证时使用 SDK <code>10.0.404</code>。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="2-%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA-web-api" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="133">2. 创建 Web API</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="135">在准备放置项目的目录执行：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>dotnet <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> webapi -n lbMcpJwtDemo -f net10.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
cd .\lbMcpJwtDemo</span></pre>
</div>
<h2 id="3-%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85%E5%8C%85" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="142">3. 安装包</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="144">为避免不同时间安装到不同主版本，本文固定使用当前项目验证过的版本：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>dotnet add package Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore --version <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span> --no-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">restore
dotnet add package Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer </span>--version <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span> --no-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">restore
dotnet add package Microsoft.IdentityModel.JsonWebTokens </span>--version <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.23</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> --no-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">restore
dotnet add package Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite </span>--version <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span> --no-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">restore
dotnet add package ModelContextProtocol.AspNetCore </span>--version <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.4</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> --no-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">restore
dotnet add package Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi </span>--version <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span> --no-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">restore

dotnet restore
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--no-restore 只是先添加引用，最后统一还原。兼容性仍需通过还原和构建验证。</span></pre>
</div>
<p>几个包的职责：</p>
<table data-line="161">
<thead class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="161">
<tr class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="161"><th>包</th><th>用途</th></tr>

</tr>

<td>验证请求中的 JWT</td>
</tr>
<tr class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="165">
<td>IdentityModel.JsonWebTokens</td>
<td>签发 JWT</td>
</tr>
<tr class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="166">
<td>EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite</td>
<td>SQLite 数据库访问</td>
</tr>
<tr class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="167">
<td>ModelContextProtocol.AspNetCore</td>
<td>注册 MCP 服务和 HTTP 端点</td>
</tr>
<tr class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="168">
<td>AspNetCore.OpenApi</td>
<td>保留开发环境 OpenAPI 文档<br><br></td>










</tr>










</tbody>









</table>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="144">&nbsp;</p>
<h3 id="4-%E6%9C%80%E7%BB%88%E7%9B%AE%E5%BD%95" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="172">4. 最终文件目录结构(<em>供参考</em>)</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">lbMcpJwtDemo
├── AppDbContext.cs
├── AuthController.cs
├── JwtTokenService.cs

│   └── launchSettings.json

</div>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="206">下面按顺序创建或替换文件。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="206">&nbsp;</p>
<h1 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="206">二：先配置数据库和 JWT 参数</h1>
<h2 id="1-%E9%85%8D%E7%BD%AE%E6%96%87%E4%BB%B6%E4%B8%8D%E8%A6%81%E4%BF%9D%E5%AD%98%E7%AD%BE%E5%90%8D%E5%AF%86%E9%92%A5" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="212">1. 配置文件不要保存签名密钥</h2>
<div>替换 appsettings.json文件</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Logging</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">LogLevel</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Default</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Information</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Microsoft.AspNetCore</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Warning</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
  },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">AllowedHosts</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Jwt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Issuer</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://localhost:5041</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Audience</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mcp-jwt-demo</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  },
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ConnectionStrings</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Default</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Data Source=app.db</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="235">几个配置的含义：</p>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="237">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="237"><code>Issuer</code>：令牌签发者标识。</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="238"><code>Audience</code>：令牌预期使用方。</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="239"><code>Default</code>：SQLite 连接字符串。</li>
</ul>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="241">这里的 <code>Issuer</code> 是签发和验证双方约定的标识，<strong>不是服务监听地址，也不会自动开启 HTTPS</strong>。</p>
<h2 id="2-%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8-user-secrets-%E4%BF%9D%E5%AD%98%E5%AF%86%E9%92%A5" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="249">2. 使用 User Secrets 保存密钥</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="251">在项目目录下执行：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>dotnet user-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">secrets init
<br>$secret </span>= <code><span>openssl rand -base64 32</span></code><span>&nbsp;<br><br></span><span>dotnet user</span>-secrets <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Jwt:Secret</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span> $secret </span></pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="139" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202611/2127802-20261120203642259-2085226252.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>这会生成一个随机的 32 字节密钥，并使用 Base64 保存。注：使用openssl工具生成一个32位字节密钥后用Base64编码，如果没有这个工具也可以使用其它方式实现。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1 id="%E5%9B%9B%E6%8E%A5%E5%85%A5-identity-%E5%92%8C-sqlite" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="273">三：接入 Identity 和 SQLite</h1>
</div>
<p>Identity 已经提供了用户管理、密码哈希和锁定机制，不需要自己再建一套密码验证逻辑。我们只需要接入数据库存储。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="277">创建 AppDbContext.cs：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> lbMcpJwtDemo;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> AppDbContext : IdentityDbContext&lt;IdentityUser&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> AppDbContext(DbContextOptions&lt;AppDbContext&gt; options) : <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(options) { }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> DbSet&lt;RefreshToken&gt; RefreshTokens =&gt; Set&lt;RefreshToken&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.OnModelCreating(builder);
        builder.Entity</span>&lt;RefreshToken&gt;(entity =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            entity.HasIndex(token </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> token.TokenHash).IsUnique();
            entity.Property(token </span>=&gt; token.TokenHash).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">44</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).IsRequired();
            entity.HasOne</span>&lt;IdentityUser&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">().WithMany()
                .HasForeignKey(token </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> token.UserId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="308">这里额外定义了一张 Refresh Token 表。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="310"><code>TokenHash</code> 的唯一索引有两个用途：</p>
<ol class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="312">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="312">避免重复记录。</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="313">加快按令牌哈希查找记录的速度。</li>
</ol>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="315">SHA-256 结果是 32 字节，转成 Base64 后长度为 44 个字符。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="317">注意：<strong>Refresh Token 的 SHA-256 哈希，与 Identity 的密码哈希不是同一种用途。</strong></p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="319">密码必须交给 Identity 管理，不要照着 Refresh Token 的方式自行处理用户密码。</p>
<h1 id="%E4%BA%94%E7%AD%BE%E5%8F%91%E5%92%8C%E9%AA%8C%E8%AF%81-access-token" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="323">四：签发和验证 Access Token</h1>
<p>创建 JwtTokenService.cs：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.IdentityModel.JsonWebTokens;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> lbMcpJwtDemo;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JwtTokenService
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> AccessTokenLifetimeSeconds = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">900</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _issuer;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _audience;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SymmetricSecurityKey _key;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JwtTokenService(IConfiguration config)
    {
        _issuer </span>= config[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Jwt:Issuer</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] ?? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Jwt:Issuer is required.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        _audience </span>= config[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Jwt:Audience</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] ?? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Jwt:Audience is required.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_issuer) || <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_audience))
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Jwt:Issuer and Jwt:Audience must not be empty.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> secret = config[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Jwt:Secret</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
            </span>?? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Configure Jwt:Secret with dotnet user-secrets or the Jwt__Secret environment variable.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> bytes = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[secret.Length];
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!Convert.TryFromBase64String(secret, bytes, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> length) || length &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">32</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Jwt:Secret must be Base64 encoded and contain at least 32 random bytes.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        _key </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SymmetricSecurityKey(bytes[..length]);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CreateAccessToken(IdentityUser user)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用字典传 Claims，JsonWebTokenHandler 会原样写进 token</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> claims = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            [JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> user.Id,
            [JwtRegisteredClaimNames.UniqueName] </span>= user.UserName ??<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> user.Id,
            [JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Jti] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
            [JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Email] </span>= user.Email ?? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            [</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">scope</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mcp:invoke</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        };

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> descriptor = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SecurityTokenDescriptor
        {
            Issuer </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _issuer,
            Audience </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _audience,
            Claims </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> claims,
            Expires </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(AccessTokenLifetimeSeconds),
            SigningCredentials </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SigningCredentials(_key, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256)
        };

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> handler = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JsonWebTokenHandler();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> handler.CreateToken(descriptor);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> TokenValidationParameters CreateValidationParameters() =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">()
    {
        ValidateIssuer </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        ValidateAudience </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        ValidateLifetime </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        ValidateIssuerSigningKey </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        ValidIssuer </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _issuer,
        ValidAudience </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _audience,
        IssuerSigningKey </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _key,
        ValidAlgorithms </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256],
        NameClaimType </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JwtRegisteredClaimNames.UniqueName,
        ClockSkew </span>= TimeSpan.FromMinutes(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    };
}


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RefreshToken
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Guid Id { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> UserId { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> TokenHash { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>;       <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 只存 SHA-256 哈希</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> DateTime ExpiresAtUtc { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> IsRevoked { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }               <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否已吊销/已轮换</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? ReplacedByTokenHash { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 被谁替换，重放检测用</span>
}</pre>
</div>
<p>这里有四个关键点：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>配置错误要在启动时暴露</strong>。密钥缺失、不是 Base64、长度不足，都直接报出明确错误，而不是等用户登录时才返回 500。</li>
<li><strong>签发和验证使用同一个服务配置</strong>。避免登录签发时使用一个 Issuer，验证时又使用另一个。</li>
<li><strong>限制签名算法</strong>。这里明确只接受：SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256</li>
<li><strong>保留一分钟时钟容差</strong>。Access Token 的 exp 设置为 15 分钟之后，但验证允许一分钟时钟偏差。因此，不要把它描述成“恰好第 900 秒后一定失效”。</li>
</ol>
<p>JWT 的 Payload 通常可以被解码读取。不要把密码、密钥等内容放进 Claims。</p>
<p><em>（签名保护的是内容完整性，不能用来隐藏敏感信息）</em></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1 id="%E5%85%ADrefresh-token-%E5%8F%AA%E4%BF%9D%E5%AD%98%E5%93%88%E5%B8%8C" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="443">五：Refresh Token 只保存哈希</h1>
<p>创建 TokenHasher.cs：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Security.Cryptography;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Text;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> lbMcpJwtDemo;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TokenHasher
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Hash(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> token)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 数据库泄露时，原始 token 不会暴露</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> bytes =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(token));
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Convert.ToBase64String(bytes);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>Refresh Token 本身由密码随机数生成器创建，原始值只返回给客户端，数据库保存它的哈希。这样，即使数据库记录泄露，攻击者也不能直接拿数据库里的 TokenHash 去调用刷新接口。</p>
<h1 id="%E4%B8%83%E5%AE%9E%E7%8E%B0%E6%B3%A8%E5%86%8C%E7%99%BB%E5%BD%95%E5%88%B7%E6%96%B0%E5%92%8C%E9%80%80%E5%87%BA" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="472">六：实现注册、登录、刷新和退出</h1>
<p>创建 AuthController.cs：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;

    [HttpPost(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">refresh</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;IActionResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Refresh(RefreshRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> SQLite's immediate transaction serializes rotation and replay handling.</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> transaction = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> db.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(cancellationToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> hash =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TokenHasher.Hash(request.RefreshToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> stored = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> db.RefreshTokens.SingleOrDefaultAsync(token =&gt; token.TokenHash ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> hash, cancellationToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (stored <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> Unauthorized(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { error = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">无效的 refresh token</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (stored.IsRevoked)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> db.RefreshTokens.Where(token =&gt; token.UserId == stored.UserId &amp;&amp; !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">token.IsRevoked)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters </span>=&gt; setters.SetProperty(token =&gt; token.IsRevoked, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">), cancellationToken);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> transaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> Unauthorized(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { error = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">检测到重放，已吊销该用户所有 refresh token</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> user = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> userManager.FindByIdAsync(stored.UserId);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (stored.ExpiresAtUtc &lt;= DateTime.UtcNow || user <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> || <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> userManager.IsLockedOutAsync(user))
        {
            stored.IsRevoked </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> transaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> Unauthorized(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { error = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">refresh token 已过期或账户不可用</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> refreshToken =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AddRefreshToken(user.Id);
        stored.IsRevoked </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        stored.ReplacedByTokenHash </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TokenHasher.Hash(refreshToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> transaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Ok(CreateTokenResponse(user, refreshToken));
    }

    [HttpPost(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">logout</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;IActionResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Logout(RefreshRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> hash =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TokenHasher.Hash(request.RefreshToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> db.RefreshTokens.Where(token =&gt; token.TokenHash == hash &amp;&amp; !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">token.IsRevoked)
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters </span>=&gt; setters.SetProperty(token =&gt; token.IsRevoked, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">), cancellationToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NoContent();
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> AddRefreshToken(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> userId)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> token = Convert.ToBase64String(RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">64</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
        db.RefreshTokens.Add(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RefreshToken
        {
            Id </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Guid.NewGuid(),
            UserId </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> userId,
            TokenHash </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TokenHasher.Hash(token),
            ExpiresAtUtc </span>= DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        });
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> token;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span> CreateTokenResponse(IdentityUser user, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> refreshToken) =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        accessToken </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> jwtTokenService.CreateAccessToken(user),
        refreshToken,
        tokenType </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Bearer</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        expiresIn </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JwtTokenService.AccessTokenLifetimeSeconds
    };
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> record LoginRequest(
    [Required, StringLength(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">256</span>)] <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserName,
    [Required, StringLength(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">128</span>)] <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Password);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> record RegisterRequest(
    [Required, StringLength(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">256</span>)] <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserName,
    [Required, StringLength(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">128</span>, MinimumLength = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span>)] <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Password,
    [EmailAddress, StringLength(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">256</span>)] <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Email);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> record RefreshRequest([Required, StringLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">128</span>)] <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> RefreshToken);</pre>
</div>
<h2 id="refresh-token-%E6%98%AF%E6%80%8E%E6%A0%B7%E8%BD%AE%E6%8D%A2%E7%9A%84" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="628">Refresh Token 是怎样轮换的</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="630">假设登录后拿到了 <code>R1</code>：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">登录
  └── 返回 R1，数据库保存 Hash(R1)

使用 R1 刷新
  ├── R1 标记为已撤销
  ├── 创建 R2
  └── 返回新的 Access Token 和 R2

再次使用 R1
  ├── 检测到已撤销令牌被使用
  └── 撤销这个用户当前所有有效 Refresh Token</span></pre>
</div>
<p>客户端每次刷新后，必须替换手里的 Refresh Token。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="669">七：注册一个 MCP 天气工具&nbsp;</h1>
<p>创建 WeatherTool.cs：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ModelContextProtocol.Server;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.ComponentModel;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> lbMcpJwtDemo;

[McpServerToolType]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WeatherTool
{
    [McpServerTool(Name </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">get_weather</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    [Description(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">获取指定城市的天气</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> GetWeather(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> city)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 演示用，实际换成你自己的业务逻辑</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{city}：多云，26℃</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这里返回的是演示数据，不是真实天气服务。</p>
<p>特别注意当前 MCP 包的写法：</p>
<blockquote>
<p>[McpServerTool(Name = "get_weather")]<br>[Description("获取指定城市的天气")]&nbsp;</p>







</blockquote>
<p>不要把 Description 当成当前版本 McpServerTool 属性的命名参数。工具定义完成后，还需要注册 HTTP transport，并给端点加授权策略。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1 id="%E4%B9%9D%E6%8A%8A%E6%89%80%E6%9C%89%E7%BB%84%E4%BB%B6%E6%8E%A5%E8%B5%B7%E6%9D%A5" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="707">八：把所有组件接起来</h1>

app.UseDefaultFiles();

{

record WeatherForecast(DateOnly Date, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> TemperatureC, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Summary)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> TemperatureF =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">32</span> + (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>)(TemperatureC / <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.5556</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

<h2 id="%E4%B8%BA%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8-addidentitycore" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="830">为什么使用 AddIdentityCore</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="832">这个项目采用 JWT，而不是 Identity Cookie 登录。因此使用：<code class="code-line language-csharp" dir="auto" data-line="836">AddIdentityCore&lt;IdentityUser&gt;()&nbsp;</code>再按需添加 Roles、EF Store、SignInManager。这样职责更清晰，也避免无意中混入 Cookie 默认认证方案。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="832">&nbsp;</p>
<h3 id="%E4%B8%BA%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E5%85%B3%E9%97%AD-claims-%E6%98%A0%E5%B0%84" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="844">为什么关闭 Claims 映射</h3>
<blockquote>
<p>options.MapInboundClaims = <span class="hljs-literal">false;</span></p>
</blockquote>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="850">关闭映射后，JWT 中的 <code>sub</code>、<code>email</code> 等名称保持原样。读取时可以直接使用：<code class="code-line language-csharp" dir="auto" data-line="854">user.FindFirst(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub)</code></p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="858">另外，通过：<code class="code-line language-csharp" dir="auto" data-line="860">NameClaimType = JwtRegisteredClaimNames.UniqueName</code></p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="864">让：<code class="code-line language-csharp" dir="auto" data-line="866">user.Identity?.Name</code>对应 JWT 中的用户名。</p>
<h3 id="%E4%B8%BA%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E9%A6%96%E9%A1%B5%E5%85%81%E8%AE%B8%E5%8C%BF%E5%90%8D" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="872">为什么首页允许匿名</h3>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="874">登录页面必须能够在未认证时打开。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="876">因此：</p>
<blockquote>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="876"><code class="code-line language-csharp" dir="auto" data-line="878">app.UseDefaultFiles();</code></p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="876"><code class="code-line language-csharp" dir="auto" data-line="878"></code><code class="code-line language-csharp" dir="auto" data-line="878">app.UseStaticFiles();</code></p>
</blockquote>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="876">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="883">公开的是页面和静态资源。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="885">真正敏感的天气数据和 MCP 工具，仍由服务端授权保护。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="887"><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p>
<h1 id="%E5%8D%81%E8%A1%A5%E4%B8%8A%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AA%E8%83%BD%E5%AE%9E%E9%99%85%E6%93%8D%E4%BD%9C%E7%9A%84%E9%A1%B5%E9%9D%A2" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="905">九：补上一个能实际操作的页面</h1>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">section</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">footer</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>令牌仅保存在当前页面内存中，刷新页面后需重新登录。直接在地址栏打开受保护 API 不会携带 JWT。<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">footer</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">main</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">body</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">html</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>

<h2>3. 页面交互</h2>
<p>创建 wwwroot/app.js：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>"use strict"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

const element </span>= (id) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> document.getElementById(id);
let mode </span>= "login"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
let tokens </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(message, status) {
    super(message);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.status =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> status;
  }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span> showMessage(text, isError = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
  element(</span>"message").textContent =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> text;
  element(</span>"message").classList.toggle("error"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, isError);
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> setMode(nextMode) {
  mode </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> nextMode;
  const registering </span>= mode === "register"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  element(</span>"email-field").hidden = !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">registering;
  element(</span>"email").disabled = !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">registering;
  element(</span>"password-hint").hidden = !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">registering;
  element(</span>"password").autocomplete = registering ? "new-password" : "current-password"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  element(</span>"password").minLength = registering ? 6 : 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  element(</span>"login-tab").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">registering));
  element(</span>"register-tab").setAttribute("aria-pressed"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, String(registering));
  element(</span>"submit-button").textContent = registering ? "注册账户" : "登录"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> clearSession() {
  tokens </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  element(</span>"auth-panel").hidden = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  element(</span>"account-panel").hidden = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  element(</span>"account-name").textContent = ""<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  element(</span>"weather-body"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).replaceChildren();
  element(</span>"weather-results").hidden = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  element(</span>"password").value = ""<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  setMode(</span>"login"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}

async </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span> api(path, { body, authenticated = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span> } =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {}) {
  const headers </span>= { Accept: "application/json"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (body) headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (authenticated) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!tokens) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ApiError("当前尚未认证，请先注册或登录。", 401<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    headers.Authorization </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `Bearer ${tokens.accessToken}`;
  }
  let response;
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    response </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await fetch(path, {
      method: body </span>? "POST" : "GET"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      headers,
      body: body </span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
      cache: </span>"no-store"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    });
  } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (error) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Error("无法连接服务，请检查网络或确认服务已启动。"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, { cause: error });
  }
  const contentType </span>= response.headers.get("Content-Type") ?? ""<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  const data </span>= response.status !== 204 &amp;&amp; (contentType.includes("/json") || contentType.includes("+json"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
    </span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await response.json()
    : </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">response.ok) {
    const details </span>= Array.isArray(data?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.errors)
      </span>? data.errors.map((item) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> item.description)
      : Object.values(data</span>?.errors ??<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {}).flat();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ApiError(
      data</span>?.error || details.join("；") || data?.detail || data?.title ||<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `请求失败（HTTP ${response.status}）`,
      response.status
    );
  }
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> data;
}

async </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> perform(action) {
  const buttons </span>= [...document.querySelectorAll("button"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)];
  buttons.forEach((button) </span>=&gt; { button.disabled = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; });
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    await action();
  } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (error) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (error <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">instanceof</span> ApiError &amp;&amp; error.status === 401 &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tokens) {
      clearSession();
      showMessage(</span>"认证已失效，请重新登录；没有账户可先注册。", <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      showMessage(error.message, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
  } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">finally</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    buttons.forEach((button) </span>=&gt; { button.disabled = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; });
  }
}

element(</span>"login-tab").addEventListener("click", () =&gt; setMode("login"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
element(</span>"register-tab").addEventListener("click", () =&gt; setMode("register"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));

element(</span>"auth-form").addEventListener("submit", (event) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  event.preventDefault();
  const body </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    userName: element(</span>"username"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).value.trim(),
    password: element(</span>"password"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).value
  };
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (mode === "register") body.email = element("email").value.trim() || <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> perform(async () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (mode === "register"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
      await api(</span>"/api/auth/register"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, { body });
      element(</span>"password").value = ""<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
      setMode(</span>"login"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
      showMessage(</span>"注册成功，请使用刚才的用户名和密码登录。"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
      element(</span>"password"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).focus();
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    tokens </span>= await api("/api/auth/login"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, { body });
    const user </span>= await api("/api/auth/me", { authenticated: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
    element(</span>"password").value = ""<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    element(</span>"account-name").textContent =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> user.userName;
    element(</span>"auth-panel").hidden = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    element(</span>"account-panel").hidden = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    showMessage(</span>"登录成功，已通过身份验证。"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    element(</span>"weather-button"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).focus();
  });
});

element(</span>"weather-button").addEventListener("click", () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> perform(async () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    const forecast </span>= await api("/weatherforecast", { authenticated: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
    const rows </span>= forecast.map((day) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      const row </span>= document.createElement("tr"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (const value of [day.date, day.temperatureC, day.summary]) {
        const cell </span>= document.createElement("td"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        cell.textContent </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> value;
        row.append(cell);
      }
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> row;
    });
    element(</span>"weather-body"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).replaceChildren(...rows);
    element(</span>"weather-results").hidden = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    showMessage(</span>"天气数据获取成功，该请求已携带 JWT。"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
  });
});

element(</span>"logout-button").addEventListener("click", () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> perform(async () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    await api(</span>"/api/auth/logout"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, { body: { refreshToken: tokens.refreshToken } });
    clearSession();
    showMessage(</span>"已退出登录，请先注册或登录后再访问受保护功能。"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    element(</span>"username"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).focus();
  });
});

setMode(</span>"login");</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="%E9%A1%B5%E9%9D%A2%E4%B8%BA%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E4%B8%8D%E6%8A%8A-token-%E6%94%BE%E8%BF%9B-localstorage" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1173">页面为什么不把 Token 放进 localStorage</h3>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1175">为了让演示保持简单，令牌只保存在当前页面内存里。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1177">因此：</p>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1179">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1179">登录成功后，当前页面可以调用 API。</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1180">刷新页面后，变量被清空，需要重新登录。</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1181">关闭页面后，不留下持久化令牌。</li>
</ul>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1183">这并不表示内存存储可以消除 XSS 风险；它只是避免在本示例中引入长期浏览器存储。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1185">页面使用 <code>textContent</code> 输出用户名和天气内容，不把接口返回值拼成 HTML。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1185">&nbsp;</p>
<h3 id="%E4%B8%BA%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E5%93%8D%E5%BA%94%E6%97%B6%E8%A6%81%E5%88%A4%E6%96%AD-content-type" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1187">为什么处理响应时要判断 Content-Type</h3>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1189">JWT 验证失败时，服务端可能只返回一个空的 <code>401</code>，没有 JSON 正文。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1191">如果直接写：<code class="code-line language-javascript" dir="auto" data-line="1193"><span class="hljs-keyword">await response.<span class="hljs-title function_">json();</span></span></code></p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1191"><code class="code-line language-javascript" dir="auto" data-line="1193"></code>页面可能先出现 JSON 解析错误，反而没有显示真正的认证提醒。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1199">这里先判断状态和 Content-Type，再处理错误。</p>
<h3 id="%E9%A1%B5%E9%9D%A2%E6%B2%A1%E6%9C%89%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E5%88%B7%E6%96%B0%E4%BB%A4%E7%89%8C" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1201">页面没有自动刷新令牌</h3>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1203">这是当前项目的明确行为：</p>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1205">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1205">Refresh API 已实现。</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1206">页面暂不自动调用 Refresh API。</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1207">页面请求收到 <code>401</code> 后，清除当前认证状态并提示重新登录。</li>
</ul>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1209">如果以后加入自动刷新，需要保证多个请求共享一次刷新操作，否则旧 Refresh Token 的并发使用可能触发重放处理。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1 id="%E5%8D%81%E4%B8%80%E5%90%AF%E5%8A%A8%E9%A1%B9%E7%9B%AE%E7%9C%8B%E7%9C%8B%E5%AE%9E%E9%99%85%E9%A1%B5%E9%9D%A2" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1213">十：启动项目，看看实际页面</h1>
<p>替换 Properties/launchSettings.json：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
  "$schema": "https://json.schemastore.org/launchsettings.json",
  "profiles": {
    "http": {
      "commandName": "Project",
      "dotnetRunMessages": true,
      "launchBrowser": false,
      "applicationUrl": "http://localhost:5041",
      "environmentVariables": {
        "ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT": "Development"
      }
    },
    "https": {
      "commandName": "Project",
      "dotnetRunMessages": true,
      "launchBrowser": false,
      "applicationUrl": "https://localhost:7046;http://localhost:5041",
      "environmentVariables": {
        "ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT": "Development"
      }
    }
  }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p dir="auto" data-line="1243">构建：dotnet build</p>
<p dir="auto" data-line="1243">启动：dotnet run --launch-profile http</p>
<p dir="auto" data-line="1243">打开：http://localhost:5041/</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1261">第一次启动时会自动初始化 SQLite 数据库。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1261">&nbsp;</p>
<h1 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1261">十一：&nbsp;使用 VS Code MCP Inspector 验证MCP调用</h1>
<p>在 VS Code 中使用 <strong>MCP Inspector 扩展面板</strong>完成配置、连接和工具调用。以下步骤对应本项目实际测试截图。</p>
<h2 id="%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%80%E6%AD%A5%E9%85%8D%E7%BD%AE%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E5%9C%B0%E5%9D%80%E4%B8%8E%E8%AE%A4%E8%AF%81%E5%A4%B4" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1709">第一步：配置服务地址与认证头</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1711">在 MCP Inspector 中设置：</p>
<table class="code-line" data-line="1713">
<thead class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1713">
<tr class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1713"><th>配置项</th><th>填写内容</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1715">
<tr class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1715">
<td>Server type</td>
<td><code>Remote (URL)</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1716">
<td>Server URL</td>
<td><code>http://localhost:5041/mcp</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1717">
<td>Authentication</td>
<td><code>Static header / token</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1718">
<td>Headers：名称</td>
<td><code>Authorization</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1719">
<td>Headers：值</td>
<td><code>Bearer &lt;登录返回的 accessToken&gt;<br><br></code></td>








</tr>








</tbody>







</table>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="477" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202611/2127802-20261120210355010-207267371.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>注：</strong>服务地址指向 <code>/mcp</code>，认证采用静态请求头。Inspector 会在每次请求中发送 <code>Authorization</code></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="%E7%AC%AC%E4%BA%8C%E6%AD%A5%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E5%B9%B6%E7%A1%AE%E8%AE%A4%E5%8F%91%E7%8E%B0%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1729">第二步：连接并确认发现工具</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1731">完成配置后点击 <strong>Connect</strong>。连接成功时，面板显示：<strong><code class="code-line language-text code-active-line" dir="auto" data-line="1735">Connected · Streamable HTTP · 1 tool</code></strong></p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="622" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202611/2127802-20261120210514455-1360919517.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>注：</strong>Inspector 已连接并发现一个工具。终端同时显示 <code>initialize</code> 和 <code>tools/list</code> 请求处理记录，说明初始化与工具发现已完成。</p>
<p>如果连接失败，可以按状态码定位：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>401</strong>：检查是否填写了 Bearer 前缀、是否误用了 Refresh Token，以及 Access Token 是否过期。重新登录取得新令牌后更新认证头并重连。</li>
<li><strong>403</strong>：检查当前令牌是否具有 mcp:invoke scope。签名有效不代表拥有工具调用权限。</li>
<li><strong>连接被拒绝</strong>：检查服务是否启动、端口是否为 5041，以及地址是否包含 /mcp。</li>

</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%89%E6%AD%A5%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8-get_weather-%E5%B9%B6%E6%A0%B8%E5%AF%B9%E7%BB%93%E6%9E%9C" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1753">第三步：调用 get_weather 并核对结果</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1755">在 <strong>Available tools</strong> 中找到 <code>get_weather</code>，点击旁边的 <strong>Run</strong>。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1757">在参数窗口中填写 <code>city</code>。本次截图使用 <code>China</code> 作为演示字符串；</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="1757">这个工具直接返回演示文本，不会检查真实城市名称，也不会查询真实天气。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="616" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202611/2127802-20261120210812710-1311030183.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>Inspector 显示工具执行成功。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em>【完】</em></p>
